annotations.title: Parental leave plan in Poland: maternity, parental and paternity leave dates and the maternity benefit (Labour Code, sickness and maternity benefits act)

description: Use for maternity, parental and paternity leave in Poland: the dates of each leave from the birth date, how to split parental leave between the mother and the father, the maternity benefit (zasiłek macierzyński) per month and in total from gross pay, 81.5% or 100% and 70%, deadlines, and the weeks a parent loses. For 800 plus, Aktywny Rodzic and family allowance, use get_family_benefits. Give the inputs and the assumptions with the result. The result is a calculation from statutory rates. It is not advice. Plan maternity, parental and paternity leave for both parents in Poland from the birth date (or the expected date), with the rules in force now. Order: maternity leave of the mother (20 weeks for one child), then her parental leave, then the father's parental leave (41 weeks for both parents, 43 for multiple births; each parent has 9 non-transferable weeks), paternity leave of up to 2 weeks from the birth. Gives the dates of each period, the split of weeks, the day the mother returns to work, and, when you give the gross pay, the maternity benefit per period, per month and in total. Gives both payment variants: 81.5% for the whole leave on the mother's request within 21 days after the birth (the father's 9 weeks always 70%), or 100% for maternity and paternity leave and 70% for parental leave. Gives the deadlines (81.5% request, paternity leave until the child is 12 months old, parental leave until the end of the year the child turns 6, notice 21 days before parental leave) and the non-transferable weeks that a parent loses. The benefit is never below the parental allowance (świadczenie rodzicielskie). A calculation, not a ZUS decision.

birth_date.description: Birth date or expected birth date, YYYY-MM-DD; default today.

children.description: Children from one birth (5 = five or more), default 1.

father_gross.description: Father's average gross monthly pay of the last 12 months in PLN. Without it: no amounts for the father.

father_parental_weeks.description: Father's parental leave weeks, with his 9 non-transferable weeks; default 9. Weeks below 9 are lost.

mother_gross.description: Mother's average gross monthly pay of the last 12 months in PLN. Without it: no amounts for the mother.

mother_parental_weeks.description: Mother's parental leave weeks, with her 9 non-transferable weeks; default 32 (all she can take when the father takes his 9).

paternity_weeks.description: Paternity leave weeks from the birth date, default 2.

prenatal_weeks.description: Weeks of maternity leave before the birth, default 0.

request_815.description: Mother's request for 81.5% within 21 days after the birth; default true. The result also gives the family total of the other variant.
